messages:
riley_csm: Heads-up  launching a micro beta with three accounts (MapleTech, SolaceAI, BrightGrid). Total 7 seats. Need: seat owners, SSO status, and plan for week1 survey.

jamie_success: I own MapleTech contact (harper@mapletech.com) and SolaceAI (marta@solace.ai). BrightGrid contact is on standby. Seats: MapleTech 3, SolaceAI 3, BrightGrid 1.

akshay_ops: BrightGrid SSO completed. MapleTech requires IdP cert rotate; okta ticket open, ETA ~24h. I can issue temp invites for MapleTech to let them test flows.

riley_csm: Do temp invites for MapleTech, but exclude them from metrics until SSO is green. We'll send the week1 survey to SolaceAI + BrightGrid on Tue 09:00 PT.

clare_prod: Please enable the cohort telemetry flag (quiet_beta_eval) for the three orgs so prompt-level telemetry links to survey answers. Also route them to the small-dedicated pool.

akshay_ops: Done: flag quiet_beta_eval toggled for mapletech, solaceai, brightgrid. Routing set to small-dedicated. Temp invite posted: https://redwood.app/invite/maple-temp-9

survey-bot: Survey scheduled: https://survey.app/mb-week1  send Tue 09:00 PT to solaceai, brightgrid. Webhook -> #beta-feedback.

jamie_success: Early note from SolaceAI: "great throughput but prompt tuning needed for one slot"  capturing in their feedback doc: https://notion.redwood.com/mb/solaceai-feedback

riley_csm: I'll attach that doc to the survey and add an optional Q about prompt regressions. Akshay, can you share a 1-pager for the temp-invite + SSO retry flow?

akshay_ops: Yep  will drop runbook in #beta-ops by EOD.

clare_prod: Playbook link for invites + starter prompts: https://docs.redwood.com/micro-beta-playbook. I'll add three seed prompts to the Examples section.

riley_csm: Perfect. I'll post final send confirmation in the morning with recipient counts. Thanks team :raised_hands:"
